options swap_delay=12 iteration=200 ignore_burst_energy=true;

raiden char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
raiden add weapon="favoniuslance" refine=3 lvl=90/90;
raiden add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
raiden add stats er=0.5 cr=0.3;

fischl char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
fischl add weapon="slingshot" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
fischl add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
fischl add stats er=0.3;

kokomi char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
kokomi add weapon="prototypeamber" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
kokomi add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
kokomi add stats er=0.3;

zhongli char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
zhongli add weapon="blacktassel" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
zhongli add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
zhongli add stats er=0.3;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active zhongli;
for let i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1 {
  zhongli skill;
  fischl skill;
  kokomi skill;
  raiden skill, burst;
  raiden attack:15;
  wait(240);
}
